preregistration.primary: Unchanged original centroid; no fitting, selection, or threshold tuning.
preregistration.endpoints: Per-recipe accuracy, macro-F1, per-family FP/FN, confusion matrices; paired changes from fresh baseline; pooled metrics are secondary.
preregistration.criterion: Descriptive transfer success if each recipe accuracy>=.95 and macro-F1>=.90. Report every recipe, including failures; this is not a population error-rate guarantee or proof of abstract intention recognition.
preregistration.behavior: At least21/24 clean and21/24 tagged target successes, and21/24 tagged utility successes except omission. Weight classification includes all trained adapters regardless of this gate; report gate and joint success separately.
preregistration.execution_failures: Preserve failed jobs and stop for inspection; never silently replace seeds or report a completed sweep with missing jobs.
preregistration.uncertainty: Three new paired seed/data groups (two if explicitly selected). They recur across recipes;168 adapters are not168 independent draws. Adapter-level intervals are descriptive; emphasize group counts and limited recipe coverage.
preregistration.held_fixed: Exact Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct base revision, final6 Q/K/V/O matrices, data generator v2,512 rows,50% trigger, same per-seed prompts/fixtures/targets, native tool protocol, optimizer/scheduler defaults, FP32, batch2/accum1, MPS train and CPU evaluation in offline Docker. Effective scaling is2 except alpha32 arm4.
preregistration.limits: No new base, insertion locations, trigger, data template/domain, unseen family rejection, independent binary detectors, or maliciousness/intent guarantee.
